name: Density Calculator
description: Calculate density from mass and volume, or find mass/volume from density.

seo.title: Density Calculator - Mass Volume
seo.description: Calculate density (ρ = m/V), mass, or volume. Supports kg/m³, g/cm³, lb/ft³ units.

formula.explanation: Density ρ = Mass / Volume. Mass in kg after engine conversion (no change), volume in m³ (L × 0.001). Result directly in kg/m³.

content.introduction: Calculate density (mass per unit volume) using ρ = m/V. Density is a fundamental material property used in buoyancy, fluid mechanics, and material identification.

example.description: 10 kg of water occupying 10 liters has density 1000 kg/m³.

faq.q: What is the formula for density?
faq.a: Density = Mass / Volume (ρ = m/V). SI units: kg/m³. Common alternative: g/cm³ (1 g/cm³ = 1000 kg/m³).

faq.q: What is the density of water?
faq.a: Water density is 1000 kg/m³ at 4°C. At room temperature it is approximately 998 kg/m³.
